result.stdout:
DbEasy CLI

Usage:
  dbeasy [command] [options]

Commands:
  project      Detect, select and validate a .csproj project.
  migration    Manage database migrations.
  snapshot     Save, load, validate and display model snapshots.
  schema       Inspect the database schema.
  database     Manage and inspect the database connection.
  environment  Verify or bind the target database environment identity.
  config       Display CLI configuration.

Global options:
  -h, --help       Display help information.
  -v, --version    Display version information.
  --verbose        Enable detailed diagnostic logging.
  --debug          Enable technical debugging information.
  --quiet          Suppress non-essential diagnostic logging.
  --log-format <text|json>
                  Select human text or NDJSON structured diagnostics.
  --output-format <text|json>
                  Select human text or one JSON command result on stdout.
  --migration-diagnostics
                  Emit migration execution failure diagnostics on stderr.
  --no-migration-diagnostics
                  Disable configured migration execution diagnostics.
  --non-interactive Never request user input; fail when required input is missing.
  --environment <name>
                  Select a DbEasy environment profile.

Environment:
  DBEASY_NON_INTERACTIVE=true
                  Enable non-interactive execution for automation.
  DBEASY_ENVIRONMENT=Staging
                  Select a DbEasy environment profile.
  DBEASY_REQUIRE_ENVIRONMENT_IDENTITY=true
                  Require target database identity verification for target-aware migrations.
  DBEASY_LOG_FORMAT=json
                  Emit structured diagnostic logs as NDJSON on stderr.
  DBEASY_OUTPUT_FORMAT=json
                  Emit one machine-readable command result on stdout.
  DBEASY_MIGRATION_DIAGNOSTICS=true
                  Enable migration execution failure diagnostics.
  DBEASY_MIGRATION_RETRY=true
                  Enable bounded safe migration retries.
  
[truncated]

  add          Create a new migration.
  list         List all migrations and their status.

Usage: dbeasy schema <command> [options]
Inspect the database schema.
Commands:
  tables    List database tables and their schemas.
  columns   List the columns of a database table.
  keys      List primary keys and unique constraints of a table.

  constraints    List CHECK and DEFAULT constraints of a table.
  display        Display the complete schema, optionally filtered by table or schema.
  export         Export schema metadata to a JSON file.
Options:
  -h, --help    Display help information.
